device: API 36 ARM64 emulator (ranchu), synthetic stylus/touch; not Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max

ghosting.rootCause: PRC prediction overlay was drawn for every tool with alpha up to 150 after the real stroke; pencil bypassed Graphite
ghosting.fix: predictive ink default off; pencil/low-confidence skipped; alpha<=45; drawn under the real stroke

pencil.rootCause: prediction outline over textured pencil; plus frozen low graphite tone for new marks
pencil.fix: prediction gate; v6 graphite coverage 125->158 for new pencil only

eraser.rootCause: radius derived from penWidth*5+5; whole-stroke default; any hit deleted entire mark
eraser.fix: independent eraserWidth four sizes; partial/whole selectable; whole removes only nearest hit; text/shapes atomic

lazyTiles.rootCause: pure pan reused the previous tile plan; newly exposed viewport had no high-resolution tiles so the base bitmap stayed blurry on half the page
lazyTiles.fix: ensureTileCoverage compares current visible page rect with plan union in page units; recomputes tile plans without rebuilding placements

textTool.fix: Type toolbar icon; page box; drag/resize; IME popup; text field in JSON/ledger/PDF; screen and PDF share sans-serif simple-break layout

limit: Emulator evidence only; real-device ink latency, IME insets, forearm contacts and crash soak pending. Preview is not a claim of stable real-device acceptance.
